title: Pulse — Ads Go-Live Checklist
description: Everything needed to turn on ad monetization (Google AdSense on web + Google AdMob on Android APK). The code is already in place and dormant until the IDs below are configured.

required: Site approval (Vercel domain must be verified and have enough content/policy-compliant pages)
Privacy policy page published on the site
GDPR consent solution for EU/UK visitors (e.g. Google UMP or an IAB CMP) before personalized ads
steps: Create AdSense account and complete signup
Add and verify the Vercel domain (pulse-gray-eight.vercel.app) in AdSense
Publish a privacy policy page and link it
Wait for AdSense site approval (can take days–weeks)
Create a Responsive ad unit (auto format)
Copy the Publisher ID + slot ID into src/ads.js
Rebuild, push, verify the ad renders above Friends' Status History

required: Android app registered with package com.pulse.statusapp
Privacy policy URL configured in Play Console
GDPR consent (UMP) for EU/UK users before personalized ads
steps: Add app with package id com.pulse.statusapp
Paste the App ID in BOTH AndroidManifest.xml and src/ads.js (they must match — enabling one without the other crashes on launch)
Paste the banner unit ID into src/ads.js
Rebuild the APK (npx cap sync android + gradle build)
Verify the test banner shows, then confirm real ads fill

notes: devMode: true loads Google's official TEST ad unit so you can preview the slot before approval — never ship with devMode on.
Until enableWebAds/enableNativeAds are true, the slot stays hidden and nothing loads.

compliance_reminders: Publish a privacy policy and link it from the app (required by AdSense, AdMob, and Google Play)
Implement consent management (GDPR for EU/UK, CCPA for California) before serving personalized ads
AdMob requires the app to be on Google Play with an approved store listing
Do not enable ads until you have real, approved IDs — placeholders crash AdMob init if only partially configured
verify_after_go_live: Web: ad renders in the slot above Friends' Status History on pulse-gray-eight.vercel.app
APK: bottom banner shows, doesn't cover the header or chat input
Both networks report impressions in their dashboards
No console errors for adsbygoogle or AdMob
